basic.title: Basic settings
basic.description: Choose main control sensors or optional advanced sensors.

thermal.title: Thermal Intelligence

data.external_heat_sources: Do you sometimes use an additional heat source?

data_description.thermal_intelligence_enabled: Passively collects qualified observations when a verified heat signal is selected. Does not affect heating control.
data_description.external_heat_sources: For example, a fireplace or air-to-air heat pump. Intermittent extra heat cannot be reliably identified; learned results remain unvalidated.

thermal.description: Passive analysis collects observations and diagnostics. Indicated heating is an estimate; verified heat delivery needs a reliable signal. Verified model learning needs qualified data. Analysis does not control the heat pump.

telemetry.title: Advanced sensors
telemetry.description: Choose heat pump sensors or optional energy meters.

notifications.title: Notifications

data_description.notify_service: Leave empty to use persistent notifications in the HA sidebar instead.
data_description.notification_level: Choose all price alerts, braking only, or none. The existing Notifications switch remains the master on/off control.
data_description.notification_cooldown_minutes: Minimum time between repeated alerts of the same type. Choose 0 for no limit; 60 minutes is recommended. Braking and preheating have independent timers.

notifications.description: Ordinary price and control notifications use this recipient, level and cooldown. Zone alerts have a separate shared recipient under Extra temperature zones.

ohmigo.title: Ohmigo and safety
ohmigo.description: Choose Ohmigo or an optional generic output.

zones.title: Extra temperature zones
zones.description: Choose a zone to edit. Zones are optional and do not affect heat control.

temperature_sources.title: Additional temperature sensors
temperature_sources.description: Optional. Weights are normalized automatically. If an indoor sensor is unavailable, the remaining sensors are reweighted. The outdoor backup is used when the primary is unavailable. These choices affect control.

data.indoor_temp_weight_1: Weight for the primary indoor sensor (from basic settings)

report_age.title: Report age – advanced
report_age.description: Defaults suit most installations. A limit that is too short can reject a working sensor and put control into safe mode. HA report time does not prove physical measurement time.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_report_max_age_minut: Default 120 minutes, based on observed reporting gaps. Adjust for your outdoor sensors. HA report time does not prove physical measurement time.
data_description.temperature_report_max_age_minutes: The default is 360 minutes, based on observed reporting intervals. Adjust it to your sensors’ observed intervals. HA report time does not establish physical measurement time.

energy.title: Electricity and energy
energy.description: Optional monitoring only. Electrical power or compressor operation alone does not prove heat delivery to radiators. Leave empty if no meter is available.

data_description.thermal_power_entity: Measured electrical input for the equipment being analysed. Energy is estimated from HA reports; it is not delivered heat.
data_description.thermal_energy_entities: Select one total meter or independent meters that can be summed. Selected meters take precedence for energy diagnostics. Only complete counter intervals with one unambiguous price are priced. Report gaps above 24 hours are excluded.

generic_output.title: Generic output – advanced
generic_output.description: Optional for special installations. A service and template can control an external output. Leave empty when unused.

data_description.modbus_service: Home Assistant service to call, for example modbus.write_register, mqtt.publish or input_number.set_value.
data_description.modbus_payload_template: YAML payload template for the service call. The template can use the fake_temp variable.
data_description.modbus_interval_minutes: Minimum time between Generic Output System service calls.

zone_1.title: Zone 1
zone_1.description: Optional monitoring without control. The zone can be monitored with alarms off. The thermostat setpoint is not the alarm threshold; a sensor near a radiator may differ from room temperature.

data_description.zone_1_notify_service: Optional override. Empty uses the shared zone recipient; if that is also empty no push is sent.
data_description.zone_1_alarm_delay_minutes: Default 15 minutes. An alarm requires at least two separate low reports.

zone_2.title: Zone 2
zone_2.description: Optional monitoring without control. The zone can be monitored with alarms off. The thermostat setpoint is not the alarm threshold; a sensor near a radiator may differ from room temperature.

data_description.zone_2_notify_service: Optional override. Empty uses the shared zone recipient; if that is also empty no push is sent.
data_description.zone_2_alarm_delay_minutes: Default 15 minutes. An alarm requires at least two separate low reports.

zone_3.title: Zone 3
zone_3.description: Optional monitoring without control. The zone can be monitored with alarms off. The thermostat setpoint is not the alarm threshold; a sensor near a radiator may differ from room temperature.

data_description.zone_3_notify_service: Optional override. Empty uses the shared zone recipient; if that is also empty no push is sent.
data_description.zone_3_alarm_delay_minutes: Default 15 minutes. An alarm requires at least two separate low reports.

zone_4.title: Zone 4
zone_4.description: Optional monitoring without control. The zone can be monitored with alarms off. The thermostat setpoint is not the alarm threshold; a sensor near a radiator may differ from room temperature.

data_description.zone_4_notify_service: Optional override. Empty uses the shared zone recipient; if that is also empty no push is sent.
data_description.zone_4_alarm_delay_minutes: Default 15 minutes. An alarm requires at least two separate low reports.

zone_notifications.title: Shared zone recipient
zone_notifications.description: Used for zone alerts and recovery when the zone has no individual recipient. Leave empty to disable push; zone alerts remain visible in diagnostics. This is separate from ordinary price notifications.

basic_settings.title: Basic settings

data_description.pid_kp: How strongly PumpSteer reacts to current temperature error. Typical range: 2.0 to 5.0.
data_description.pid_ki: How much PumpSteer corrects long-term drift. Typical range: 0.01 to 0.05.
data_description.pid_kd: How much PumpSteer reacts to fast temperature changes. Keep at 0.0 unless you tune it intentionally.
data_description.pid_integral_clamp: Limits built-up long-term correction to reduce windup. Typical range: 5.0 to 10.0.
data_description.pid_output_clamp: Caps how many degrees PumpSteer may adjust the setpoint.
data_description.preheat_boost_enabled: When enabled, PumpSteer heats extra before expensive periods to build up thermal mass.

basic_settings.description: Choose one indoor and one outdoor sensor and electricity price sensors. These inputs affect heat control. Additional sensors are optional.

heat_sensors.title: Advanced sensors

data.thermal_heat_activity_entity: Verified heat delivery to the home (optional)

data_description.thermal_heat_activity_entity: A binary sensor whose on means measured heat delivery to the home and off means none. Compressor status or hot-water mode alone is insufficient. Report times do not establish physical measurement time.
data_description.thermal_supply_temp_entity: Select a radiator-circuit sensor. Temperature is an indicator, not measured heat output.
data_description.thermal_supply_threshold: Set for your heating system. An unsuitable threshold can misclassify heat.
data_description.thermal_detection_method: Automatic uses qualified signals and reports uncertainty. Manual retains the supply threshold.
data_description.thermal_heating_mode_entity: Select a verified radiator mode. Required for the supply indicator.
data_description.thermal_heating_mode_inverted: Enable only when off means radiator mode. Unknown or stale status suspends learning.

heat_sensors.description: Optional monitoring. Automatic uses available indications; Manual uses the selected supply sensor and threshold; Verified requires a reliable binary heat signal. Compressor and electrical power do not prove radiator heat. These choices do not enable control.

ohmigo_settings.title: Ohmigo and safety

data_description.ohmigo_entity: PumpSteer will push the fake outdoor temperature to this number entity after each update. Leave empty to disable. Toggle without reconfiguring using the 'Ohmigo Push' switch.
data_description.ohmigo_interval_minutes: Minimum time between pushes to Ohmigo. Default 5 minutes. Changes below 0.2 °C are treated as unchanged, but the current setpoint is resent when the interval is due to keep the Ohmigo watchdog alive.
data_description.ohmigo_relay_entity: Optional switch entity for the Ohmigo Active/Bypass relay. When configured, PumpSteer exposes a separate Relay Guard switch. The guard only recovers an explicit OFF state while Ohmigo Push is ON; unknown or unavailable states never cause a relay command.

ohmigo_settings.description: Ohmigo Push sends the temperature output to the device. The relay is the physical output; Relay Guard supervises safe recovery. These choices affect actual control.

heat_details.title: Additional heat pump sensors
heat_details.description: Optional for deeper passive analysis. Compressor operation or electricity consumption does not prove radiator heat. Leave fields empty if sensors are unavailable.

data_description.thermal_hot_water_mode_entity: On means verified hot-water operation. Heat learning pauses when on or unknown; unknown periods are not classified.
data_description.thermal_compressor_entity: Compressor status alone does not prove radiator heating.
data_description.thermal_return_temp_entity: Used only together with other qualified signals.

error.heat_signal_alias: The heat signal must be a separate radiator heat indicator.
